cards.english_title: Why Seoul Stocks Fell Before Two Big Tests
cards.korean_desc: 한국 주식은 2026년 10월 26일 코스피 5,469.47로 마감했다 투자자들은 월가 하락과 반도체 실적과 연준 결정을 기다렸다 외국인은 6,955억 원을 팔고 기관과 개인은 샀다 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 각각 10월 29일과 28일 실적을 발표한다

cards.english_title: KB’s Data Leak Grew After a Closer Check
cards.korean_desc: KB국민은행은 2026년 10월 26일 피해자 2,210명을 밝혔다 은행은 연결된 시스템과 과정을 조사해 2,091명을 추가로 찾았다 새 피해자는 고객 1,631명과 임직원 460명이다
cards.english_desc: KB Kookmin Bank said on October 26, 2026, that 2,210 people were affected by a data leak. The bank discovered 2,091 additional people during a close review of connected systems and processes. The newly counted group included 1,631 customers and 460 company executives and employees.

cards.takeaway_english: The next concern is whether the bank can identify every affected person and prevent another breach.

cards.english_title: ILLIT Turns One-Sided Love Into Defiance
cards.korean_desc: 아일릿은 2026년 10월 26일 서울에서 다섯 번째 EP를 냈다 노래는 감정이 돌아오지 않는 관계를 따라간다 타이틀곡은 친절을 사랑으로 착각한 마음을 범죄처럼 표현한다 아일릿은 모카의 회복과 휴식 중 네 명으로 활동한다
cards.english_desc: ILLIT released its fifth EP, Break Even, in Seoul on October 26, 2026. The songs follow a relationship where emotional effort is no longer returned. The lead single, You’re Under Arrest, uses playful crime language for confusing kindness with romance. ILLIT will promote as four members while Moka continues her recovery and hiatus.
cards.hook: ILLIT’s new album walks away from one-sided love.
cards.takeaway_english: ILLIT’s new era treats walking away as a decision, not a defeat.
cards.takeaway_korean: 아일릿은 떠남을 패배가 아닌 선택으로 그린다

why_it_matters.english: The album shows how pop music can turn disappointment into self-protection.
